title: Best Video Marketing Strategists (2026): Plan Videos That Perform
description: How to hire a video marketing strategist to plan video types, channels, budgets and measurement: deliverables, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Video marketing strategists help businesses decide which videos to make, where to publish them and how to measure their impact: product demos, short social clips, testimonials, tutorials and ads. A good strategy makes each video serve a clear purpose in the customer journey. It goes wrong when companies produce expensive videos without a distribution plan, or copy trends that do not fit their audience. This guide helps you plan video investment wisely.

faq.q: Is this the same as video production?
faq.a: No. Strategy decides what to make and why; production makes it.

faq.q: Which video types should I start with?
faq.a: Often short explainers, product demos and customer stories, depending on your goals.

faq.q: How do I measure video results?
faq.a: Watch time, clicks, conversions and sales linked to each video's purpose.
